item.description:
Projects can now sit inside another project. A project's own chats come first, then each project inside it as a heading you can fold, on the Mac, iPhone, iPad and both Duo layouts. Headings with no open chats fold into one "Also in …" line.
A project inside another can also hold app folders. A chat running in one shows its folder on the row, for example "in Tonight".
Right-click a project and choose Put Inside to move it into another project. Take Out of moves it back, and Add as Folder Of adds it as a folder. Drag headings to reorder them. New Chat groups projects under their parent.
Agents can arrange projects too, with seance-agent's projects commands.
